items.quote: Please send us the certificate for the winter semester 2026/27 by 11 January 2027.
items.computation: The letter states an explicit calendar date by which the certificate must arrive at the insurer: 11 January 2027. No period calculation is needed; the date is used as written.

items.quote: If it does not reach us by then, we will switch your policy to the standard rate from February 2027.
items.computation: The letter states the consequence takes effect 'from February 2027' if the certificate has not arrived by 11 January 2027. Taking this literally, the standard rate would apply from the first day of February 2027.
